method.transport: packaged CLI -> daemon -> loopback WebGateway -> native Safari
method.authority: fresh isolated ControlStores seeded by the packaged browser E2E
method.interaction: macOS accessibility tree plus native keyboard and accessibility actions
method.launchCapability: independent one-time capability entered through native keyboard; value not retained
method.shutdownCheck: the staged review hold was released after the read and keyboard path; both loopback listener ports were then closed

excludedClaims: VoiceOver speech order, announcements, rotor navigation, or verbosity
native Safari mutation, session-revocation, console, CSP, performance, or axe automation
human product, content, comprehension, or accessibility approval
